description: This PHP file defines a Symfony event subscriber class 'FunctionalTestingPluginSubscriber' which listens to controller events and performs access control checks related to a functional testing feature within the OrangeHRM software. It includes methods for event subscription and handling, and relies on external configuration and controller classes.

classes.name: FunctionalTestingPluginSubscriber
classes.description: An event subscriber class that listens to Symfony kernel controller events and enforces access restrictions for the '/functional-testing' path during production mode by throwing a ForbiddenException.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events to which this class subscribes, specifically the Kernel::CONTROLLER event with a high priority to trigger 'onControllerEvent'.

methods.name: onControllerEvent
methods.description: Handles the controller event; checks if the request path starts with '/functional-testing' or the controller instance is of a specific type, and if in production mode, throws a ForbiddenException.

methods.name: getControllerInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the controller object from the event, assuming it is the first element of the controller array.
